terra.problem: The joke about betting on something shinier makes the gift of eternal life sound disappointing.
The mustache joke is about age, which the hard rules prohibit.
Jesus going from place to place is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The explanation repeats the same point three times without adding insight or personality.
The quote uses Jesus’ first-person words before identifying Him as the speaker.
‘The disciples stay in the world’ states an outcome. Jesus says He is not asking the Father to take them out.
‘Here it happens by the truth’ states sanctification as an accomplished outcome, while Jesus is asking the Father to sanctify them.
The passage does not say how many future believers there will be or that they were not yet around when Jesus prayed.
‘Verse 23 says’ does not identify Jesus as the speaker before quoting His first-person words.
The passage says the Father loved Jesus before the foundation of the world, not when that love started. It also does not say this was before anything existed.
